ops.title: tccd keys bare-CLI TCC grants by codesign identifier ONLY when reverse-DNS-shaped; basename default → path-keyed → re-prompt per install path
ops.body: macOS tccd resolves a TCC client (any service: Network Volumes, AppData/group-container, etc.) for a bare Mach-O CLI by its code-signing identifier ONLY when that identifier is reverse-DNS-shaped (dotted) — then the TCC.db row is `client_type=0` keyed on the identifier and survives upgrades. `codesign` defaults the identifier to the binary basename; an undotted basename (or adhoc/linker signing, `Identifier=a.out`) makes tccd fall back to the literal resolved executable path (`client_type=1`) — every new install path (brew Cellar version dir, HEAD rebuild) is a fresh client and re-prompts. Developer ID signing alone is NOT sufficient (cc-pool 0.21–0.44 was Dev-ID signed as `cc-pool`, still path-keyed, 29 rows); no embedded Info.plist is needed (claude/codex CLIs prove it). Inspect: `sqlite3 -readonly ~/Library/Application\ Support/com.apple.TCC/TCC.db "SELECT service,client,client_type FROM access"`. Fixed in cc-pool v0.45.0 (`com.yasyf.cc-pool` via the tap's `MACOS_CODESIGN_IDENTIFIER` knob, homebrew-tap v1.1.0) — pattern applies to any signed CLI (cc-notes mount-holder etc.). Pre-granting TCC is impossible outside MDM PPPC; sudo/tccutil can't. See [[claude-pool-project]], [[cc-pool-fileprovider-signing-reality]].
